_comment: Template package.json for a Tauri v2 plugin's JavaScript bindings. When you copy this folder to a new plugin: (1) rename the package name '@marrionesa/plugin-template' -> '@marrionesa/plugin-<name>'; (2) update description; (3) keep the dual license 'MIT OR Apache-2.0' to match the Rust crate. NOTE: this file MUST stay valid JSON — comments such as // or # are not allowed in package.json.
